modelCandidates.title: Create booking accepts out-of-range seat counts
modelCandidates.rule: Bookings must have an integer from 1 through 8 seats.
modelCandidates.observed: After creating normal booking 'Test Desk Alpha' with 2 seats, created 'Edge Zero' with 0 seats shown as 'Edge Zero confirmed 0 seats', created 'Edge Nine' with 9 seats shown as 'Edge Nine confirmed 9 seats', and created 'Edge Negative' with -3 seats shown as 'Edge Negative confirmed -3 seats'. Page header states 'Bookings must have an integer from 1 through 8 seats'.

modelCandidates.title: Edit booking allows changing to 0 seats
modelCandidates.rule: Bookings must have an integer from 1 through 8 seats.
modelCandidates.observed: Existing booking 'Test Desk Alpha confirmed 4 seats' was edited by entering 0 in 'Update seats for Test Desk Alpha' and clicking Update seats, resulting in 'Test Desk Alpha confirmed 0 seats' with 'Your changes were saved.' No rejection.

claims: Real Meta-driven owned local workflow only. No Fly lifecycle, public-site or complete SELF clearance.
